The '''Abrihom system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the ''[[Abrihom]]'' [[Space station/Legends|station]].
